title: Unique lifting of factorizations across locally nilpotent ideals
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $J\subseteq A$ a locally nilpotent ideal. For every monic polynomial $f\in A[T]$ and every factorization of its reduction $\overline f\in(A/J)[T]$ into monic polynomials $g_0h_0$ generating the unit ideal, there exist unique monic polynomials $g,h\in A[T]$ with $f=gh$ and reductions $g_0,h_0$ modulo $J$.
